# Vendor / reference material (IEEE)

Third-party LaTeX and BibTeX bundles used as **reference** for the conference paper. The working build uses the copies in the parent `paper/` directory (`IEEEtran.cls`, `IEEEtran.bst`) next to `shortpaper.tex`.

| Path | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `IEEE-conference-template-062824/` | Official IEEE conference LaTeX template (Jun 2024). |
| `IEEEtranBST2/` | IEEEtran BibTeX styles (`.bst`), example `.bib` files, HOWTO. |
| `ieeetran_pkg/` | Full IEEEtran journal package (bare demos, tools, extra `.bst`). |
| `IEEEtran/` | Expanded IEEEtran distribution (from `IEEEtran.zip`). |
| `IEEEtran.zip` | Original archive (kept for provenance). |

Do not edit these trees for day-to-day manuscript work; change `paper/shortpaper.tex` and related files in `paper/` instead.
